data.content:
Chapecoense are bottom and effectively relegated. The experts put them on 18 points from 30 or 31 games, with three wins and a goal difference of -32.
 Their recent form is very poor. They have lost four of their last five. Those results include 0-4 at Vitória and 1-4 at home to Athletico-PR.
 Their home defence leaks. They have conceded 13 goals in their last five home league games.
 Their squad is thin. Heitor, Carvalheira, Robert Conceição and Balieiro are injured, and Kauan is suspended. [...] Chapecoense are bottom with three wins, a goal difference of -32, four defeats in their last five, and 13 goals conceded in their last five home games, plus injuries and a suspension. Fluminense are fifth and chasing the top four, but arrive on about 70 hours' rest after a shootout loss, with Savarino suspended and several attackers out or doubtful.
